      "observations": [
        "Read the full 20-path reland diff and every changed test body. Comparing per-path added/removed line sequences with the 19-path original 4230 identifies 14 identical change sequences and six changed/new paths; this does not claim full-file or unchanged-caller identity. The 4251 backout was separately scoped to 14 of the original 19 paths, so the reland is not treated as a simple inverse of that backout.",
        "The reland fixes the XML boundary: combined type=exchange input still checks external ewsURL and assigns sanitized input to internal exchangeURL. The original patch changed both names to exchangeURL. The new local XML regression supplies an ewsURL element, asserts internal exchangeURL and owaURL, and is invoked by run_test. It does not fetch or validate a whole external provider corpus.",
        "The reland adds getConfiguredHost and model helper tests. For a recognized Exchange configuration, host lookup uses URL.parse(exchangeURL)?.hostname without a fallback to incoming.hostname. Other types use hostname. The optional-chain result can be undefined although the summary says null and the return annotation is nullable; this is a local documentation limit.",
        "Graph option value 5, shared Exchange capture, CSS preference hiding, the Exchange label ID and optional outgoing metadata matching remain the same changed-line sequences as the original. Reuse their existing focused lessons. New Graph account assertions also verify that the Graph API URL is stored under ews_url; the incoming model property rename does not rename that stored key.",
        "The owned OAuth visibility path broadens the override predicate to isExchangeConfig and otherwise calls getConfiguredHost with a truthy-host guard before provider lookup. Fixed accepted visibility now sanitizes live input directly to avoid stale config; the accepted AccountConfig helper still keeps URL-first/no-fallback behavior. These are separate caller phases.",
        "The advanced-config event unwraps the captured config, supplies SMTP only for non-Exchange with no outgoing type, marks handlesOutgoing for recognized Exchange, fills variables and awaits advanced setup. Backend handling aliases outgoing to incoming before server lookup and explicitly tests outgoing EWS/Graph type before nsIEwsServer.initialize(exchangeURL). Replacing that outgoing check with the incoming-type helper would change its receiver contract.",
        "The changed widget tests directly check preference-driven CSS visibility, popup cleanup, Graph selection rather than the earlier accidental EWS selection, captureState().config.incoming.type, URL visibility, username and completion. Model tests directly check EWS/Graph/IMAP classification and derived hosts. The advanced test checks graph server type and ews_url. These are source assertions, not executed authentication or send/receive results.",
        "The changed updateFields context retains assert(config instanceof AccountConfig) without an expected-behavior message; the exact same AccountCreationUtils assertion helper blob supplies only a generic fallback. Changed test assertions have non-empty expected-state messages containing should. Async advanced test helpers still annotate raw return types instead of Promise results, and an EWS-only comment is shared by the Graph caller. The advanced Graph task still does not await its final popPrefEnv; these limits are not erased by Done labels.",
        "Accepted source objects from the completed original 4230 audit are reused byte-for-byte after exact line/blob checks. They cover current classification/completeness, capture/validation/markup, storage, outgoing contracts, matching, preference/default, CSS, OAuth scopes, renamed native local-store handling and separate constructors, plus the accepted legacy XML and host/OAuth windows. Later defaults, InputSanitizer, live-input validation, configureOutgoingFromIncoming, IExchangeOutgoingServer.exchangeUrl and separate constructors are not attributed to this reland.",
        "The exact complete original Bug 1995827 current 0–5 is reused by original private ID and scope. It describes preference-hidden Graph as an Exchange subprotocol, splits frontend work from 1995821 and records the original landing, no-Bug backout and later reland.",
        "The complete retained D272556 creation-to-final timeline and all 55 actual current/outdated submitted inline bodies were read, including code-only suggestions. Two older timeline loads were expanded by the original collector; there are no actual summary/test-plan edits. Reuse the original ID without a new browser capture or independent confirmation count.",
        "The original landing explicitly had ongoing or failed builds. Re-review identifies over-replacing the external ewsURL field as the bustage cause and adds an XML regression. This reported cause matches the owned original/parser delta, but no external ISPDB body or runtime reproduction was inspected.",
        "The intermediate separate graphURL/ewsURL proposal and Boolean type-specific completeness suggestion did not become this reland's design. Inline 1508255 explicitly returns to exchangeURL internally while retaining helpers/tests. The final source, rather than Done or a team preference, decides adoption.",
        "The CSS preference query, BrowserTestUtils visibility checks, lower-case task names, popup/preference cleanup, Graph rather than EWS selection, new Fluent ID, awaited advanced helper and returned tab-manager wording are present in the owned source. The suggested incoming helper for the outgoing condition was rejected on receiver scope; the explicit outgoing check remains.",
        "Acceptance, conditional test approval, historical Try links/build events, later review and reland are separate from fresh execution. No account creation, accessibility, authentication or send/retrieval success is claimed."
